reset_app.title: Danger Zone — Reset application
reset_app.desc: Deletes the entire database (all places, reviews, comments, groups and users), keeping only your current user account.
reset_app.prompt:
⚠️ DANGER ZONE ⚠️

This action will delete ALL places, comments, notes, groups, invitations and collaborator users from the database.

ONLY your administrator account will be preserved.

To confirm full reset, type "RESETEAR" in capital letters:

settings.title: Settings & Maps
settings.subtitle: API Keys and map providers
settings.carto_placeholder: Enter your carto.com API Key if you have one...
settings.carto_hint: If left blank, GastroMap automatically uses open OpenStreetMap layers at no cost and without watermarks.
settings.google_places_placeholder: AIzaSy... (leave blank to use free OpenStreetMap)
settings.google_places_hint: When configured, the «Analyze» button in /new fetches official name, editorial description, price level, and plans from Google Places API (New). Without a key, it falls back to free OpenStreetMap + Open Graph.
settings.google_places_guide_title: How to get your Google Places API Key?
settings.google_places_guide_step1: Open Google Cloud Console and create or select a project.
settings.google_places_guide_step2: Go to APIs & Services › Library, search for and enable «Places API (New)».
settings.google_places_guide_step3: Go to Credentials › Create credentials › API key, copy the key and paste it above (optionally restrict it to «Places API (New)»).
settings.google_places_guide_note: Google includes a free monthly usage tier (more than enough for personal or group use at €0). Completely optional.
settings.test_ok: ✓ API Key is valid and working with Places API (New)
settings.test_empty: Enter an API Key before testing.
settings.test_network_error: Could not reach Google Places API (network error or timeout).
